entry_state: Expected future conditional standard deviation,root expected variance and today's remaining-payment spread are different quantities. exit_state: The reserving exchange preserves exact law,draw status and durable-resume requirements without claiming a working adapter. Acquisition assets use distinct whole-group and renewal recoverability tests,then enter recognized groups at their remaining carrying amounts. Premium receipt changes cash without immediate profit. The onerous acquisition-and-treaty example has reconciled its timely-treaty path to final cash35;the alternative timing discussion continues next.
findings: Scaled Poisson and negative binomial can match moments yet differ in support;the payment unit is substantive. A seed alone is not a durable checkpoint.
The acquisition impairment example avoids overlapping loss by subtracting the first test's recognised amount in the renewal test;reversal does not create cash or early renewal recognition.
The recognition bridge removes acquisition assets and reduces initial CSM. Keeping the assets and overstating margins can still balance equity,so component checks are necessary.
The onerous example includes already-paid acquisition costs once and keeps loss recovery inside the treaty asset. No new confirmed local defect.
